descriptions.gosany-platform: Gosany enterprise platform — modular monolith for hospitality and enterprise products (GOSEP).
descriptions.gosany-gohostels: GoHostels One platform — hostel discovery, booking, rent payments, and tenancy management for students and landlords in Tanzania.
descriptions.pharmacy-pms: Pharmacy operations platform — multi-branch inventory with batch and expiry tracking, real-time stock control, sales, purchases, expense management, role-based access, and automated reports.
descriptions.go-makazi: Tanzania property rental platform for tenants and landlords.
descriptions.nyumba-cloud: Property and tenancy management — units, tenants, leases, invoices, and payments.
descriptions.ibs-web-d: Payroll & accounting software for growing teams in Tanzania. IBS Payroll Gateway (PPGS-V1) keeps compensation accurate and compliant; IBS Accounting (PASG-V1) delivers general ledger, reporting, and period close — plus sales & purchase invoicing, inventory, fixed assets, bank reconciliation, VAT, multi-currency treasury, and financial statements. Deploy as payroll-only, accounting-only, or the integrated Payroll + Accounting stack (PAPSG-V1).
descriptions.ibs-web: Earlier Next.js application for IBS Accounts — accounting and business management.
descriptions.ibs-accounts-website: Official product website — annual subscription packages in TZS, payroll bands by headcount, accounting tiers, complimentary training, year-round support, and onboarding for finance and HR teams.
descriptions.voguethics: Cybersecurity and security awareness training from Tanzania.
descriptions.simu-jiji: Storefront, API, and PocketBase backend for the Simu Jiji phone business platform.
descriptions.blb: BELIBELI Digital Manager — property, units, tenants, leases, invoices, and payments management.
descriptions.mukwano: Mukwano Financial Services — secure microfinance platform with borrowers, loans, centers and groups mapped to branches, disbursements, repayments and installment schedules, arrears and defaulter tracking, portfolio dashboards, role-based access for admins, branch managers and loan officers, live sync, and reports.
descriptions.mukwano-loans: Microfinance loan management for Mukwano Financial Services — borrowers, centers and groups, loan disbursements, repayment schedules, collections and recovery, arrears and defaulters, branch-scoped dashboards, and role-based access with encrypted sessions.
